quote: The Kansas Pipe Line & Gas Co. is pushing construction work on its new 16-inch pipe line from Medicine Lodge in Barber County, Southwest Kansas, to Grand Island, in southern Nebraska.
ref_places: Supporting only, not the basis for the match. This passage: McPherson ('his unit of the line to McPherson'); trace ends ~24 km from McPherson, which does not separate it from neighbouring lines. Corroborating source (OGJ 1931-07-09 v.30 i.8 p.32, towns served by the company): Concordia 3.3 km and Salina 11 km from trace.
notes: Basis for the match: the 1931 sheet letters the traced line KANSAS PIPE and the passage names the same company. Adjacent lines are labelled differently (MO. VALLEY = 873; NATURAL GAS CO OF AM = 846/874). Not claimed: material (not stated); build date (passage says only in progress); pipe weight/wall (stated for Medicine Lodge-Kingman, south of this section).

quote: ...its new 16-inch pipe line from Medicine Lodge in Barber County, Southwest Kansas, to Grand Island, in southern Nebraska.
notes: Stated for the new line as a whole, Medicine Lodge to Grand Island; not stated per stretch. The 1931 map gives no size for this line.

quote: Reece McGee is laying about 40 miles of pipe west of McPherson and already has completed his unit of the line to McPherson. Crews are being sent into Nebraska.
notes: Line still under construction north of McPherson on 1929-10-03. Consistent with the GeoPackage (absent on the Aug 1929 sheet, present by 1931; existed_from ../1931 proves existence by 1931, not a build date). The GeoPackage does not confirm it.
